text:
lina: heads-up from FinServ pilot call: they want a clear playbook for KMS integrations + audit evidence for SOC2 readiness. asking for an "onboarding playbook" we can hand to customers.

marc: can we scope two things: (A) onboarding steps + timeline, (B) launch criteria for product (what we gate on before GA). otherwise we keep doing bespoke integrations.

arjun: +1. Proposed onboarding phases: discovery (1w), staging connect (2w), validation & pen-test (1w), cutover + monitoring (3d). Govcloud/HSM adds time.

emily: Sales note: want a "non-legal" checklist they can show buyers. one pager, callouts for required fields (region, role ARN, TLS cert, rotation policy).

lina: Example checklist lines: `kms_endpoint`, `role_arn`, `key_alias`, `rotation_window_days`, `escrow_optin` and optionally `hsm_cert`. Keep it simple.

marc: For launch criteria (internal):
- Documented runbook + runbook CI test
- Automated smoke that uses a test key to sign+verify
- SOC2 artifact bundle created from event logs (rotation, import, access events)
- Pen-test result OR escrow handler attestation
- Support-oncall trained
These must be met for GA.

arjun: Tech notes: we need to ensure audit logs preserve original KMS event timestamps and principal ARNs. Also we should surface a per-tenant audit export (CSV/NDJSON) for evidence requests.

emily: Customers will ask about retention. can we propose standard buckets: 30d (default), 365d (enterprise), and custom with legal signoff?

lina: retention buckets make sense. add SLA implications: longer retention -> higher storage + e-discovery cost. call that out in pricing.

legal-bot: Reminder: any customer-defined retention beyond default requires updated DPA addendum & internal legal review.

marc: Prioritization ask: rank this vs. other Q2 items. I propose this is P0 for enterprise motion because multiple pilots are blocked.

arjun: Resource ask: need 2 eng sprints to finish runbook automation + 1 infra sprint for log export infra. dev time estimate: ~3 dev-weeks.

emily: Sales will fund concierge integration at a premium. recommend we offer two SKUs: Self-serve (docs + automation) and Concierge (SLA + 4-week staffed onboarding).

lina: Action items:
- marc: draft launch gating doc with the checklist above by Tue EOD
- arjun: prototype audit-export format and smoke test script by Thu
- emily: one-pager checklist (customer-facing) + pricing sketch by Wed
- legal-bot: flag required DPA changes and cost-of-review estimate
- ops-bot: create ticket for runbook automation

ops-bot: :page_facing_up: Created ticket #5120 "kms integration playbook & audit-export" assigned to eng-infra

emily: let's also surface a short FAQ about escrow vs cross-account keys. I'll draft a short blurb.

lina: thanks all. i'll consolidate and ping pilot leads. :rocket:
